The reflection diag(1,-1,1,...) preserves the reference tuple and swaps M,N, giving the normalization. At u*=(e1+e2)/sqrt(2) and w*=(e1-e2)/sqrt(2), the zonotope face spans have dimensions n-1, the F-face has dimension 1, and the combined face span has dimension n-1 for n=4,5,6. These directions lie in the mixed-area-measure support, while the support-function values force incompatible dilations 1+sqrt(2) and sqrt(2)-1. Thus the claimed AF equality and failure of translation/support-only explanation are correct.
